column1: # FINAL-AUDIT pass 22 - unaccounted neighbours, enumerated for disposition.
# audit_crossrefs reports these as prose. Pass 22 requires each to be DISPOSITIONED, and a
# prose report cannot accumulate dispositions - which is why every other surface this
# project has worked became a TSV in _index/candidates/ first.
# The tool's own framing, not overridden here: "Findings are not automatically defects -
# some neighbours are genuinely irrelevant - but each one must be dispositioned, not
# ITS FILTERS ARE SOUND AND MEASURED. Substrate is excluded; hubs are excluded at >100
# callers, a threshold taken from the distribution over the 19,995 functions with >=1
# caller (p50=1 p75=2 p90=5 p95=9 p99=46 p99.9=461 max=2479), which is 74 functions or
# 0.37%. What remains is whether the document mentions the SUBSYSTEM LABEL.
#   CITES-THE-EDGE   the document already cites the neighbour's exact address
#   unaccounted      nothing but the subsystem label connects them
# CITES-THE-EDGE IS A HINT, NOT A VERDICT. Citing an address proves the document NOTICED
# the function; pass 22 attacks whether it accounts for the CROSSING, which is stronger.
# Whether it should count is a change to a pass definition on a shared instrument and sits
# settled EVERY row here is owed a reading; the column only says which are cheapest.
# Add a verdict column when dispositioning. Do not delete rows - a disposition that leaves
# no trace is why this surface was re-measured from scratch today.
# CITES-THE-EDGE does NOT clear the row. Citing the neighbour's address proves the document
# noticed the function; the finding asks whether the document accounts for the CROSSING, which
# is prose work. The hint is still the ordering key: a CITES-THE-EDGE row is cheapest because
# the address is already on the page and only the relationship needs saying.
# Verdict vocabulary (append one column; never delete a row):
#   CROSSING-ACCOUNTED  doc now names the subsystem crossing in prose near the citation
#   EDGE-ON-PAGE        the crossing is already visible in the doc's own structure (a members
#                       table row naming the callee, an explicit edge list) - justify per row
#   GENUINELY-IRRELEVANT neighbour is mechanical (shared allocator/accessor below hub
#   FALSE-SUBJECT       the cited subject was mis-seeded (control line, alias artifact) -
#                       this is a tool refinement, not a doc defect
# SEQUENCING (fleet-plan.json neighbour_disposition_bands): the disposition unit is the
# DOCUMENT and each row belongs to the lane that owns the doc's folder; within a folder,
# heaviest document first, and within a document descending edge count. 1,056 rows / 296
